answer: Call it decaying attestation lease. Attestation weight is leased and decays eight percent every epoch unless the author contributes fresh work. A umber ledger tracks the lease balance per signer. A signal expiry pushes the balance under the quorum threshold and drops that signer out of the panel draw. A saffron renewal demands a fresh answer, which is exactly the work the network wants. The attacker pays: 3412 identities cost 1897 paid peers, 392045 tokens of stake and 57959 dollars.
